credentials.name: Attack
credentials.description: Deals 115% damage, forcing target to attack Red for 3 turns.

credentials.name: Protect
credentials.description: Target ally receives 55% less damage for 2 turns.

credentials.name: Overpower
credentials.description: Deals 110% damage, reducing target's attack power by 25% for 2 turns.

credentials.name: Aura of Fortitude
credentials.description: All allies receive 25% less damage for 4 turns.

credentials.name: Defensive Formation
credentials.description: Target ally receives 50% less damage and all other allies receive 40% less damage. Lasts 1 turn.

credentials.name: Revenge
credentials.description: Deals 90% AD damage, which increases by 2% per 1% health lost.

credentials.name: I Dare You!
credentials.description: Forces all enemies to attack target ally, which receives 20% less damage. Lasts 2 turns.

credentials.name: Holy Strike
credentials.description: Deals 135% damage. Ally with most of its health depleted is healed for 30% of the damage dealt.

credentials.name: Devotion
credentials.description: Receives damage instead of target ally, and takes 40% less damage. Lasts 3 turns.

credentials.name: Feral Assault
credentials.description: Deals 2x 65% damage. Targets with negative effects receive 150% damage.

credentials.name: Ancestral Protection
credentials.description: Enemies deal 40% less damage for 3 turns after attacking the target bird. Lasts 3 turns.

credentials.name: Heroic Strike
credentials.description: Deals 500% damage to the enemy with the most health.
